name: julia milreu
hero: I'm a SeniMotion Designer making Mobile Games, Global Events, and Digital Campaigns a little harder to scroll past.
heroEmphasis: Let's give people a reason to watch!
about:
I'm a Senior Motion Designer with over a decade of experience bringing stories to life through motion.

Throughout my career, I've led creative teams and delivered high-impact visual campaigns for global brands in the mobile games and marketing industries, from Creative Ads at Fanatee to full-scale event identities at App Growth Summit.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Digital Animation Design and a specialization in UX Design, combining artistic foundations with user-centered thinking to create effective visual communication.

Beyond the screen, I'm passionate about crafting magical worlds inspired by my love for fantasy and Dungeons & Dragons. I try to channel that same sense of wonder into every project I create.
